question: Taken all together, how would you say things are these days—would you say that you are very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy?
response_options: 1 = very happy; 2 = pretty happy; 3 = not too happy.

question: Taking things all together, how would you describe your marriage? Would you say that your marriage is very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy?
response_options: 1 = very happy; 2 = pretty happy; 3 = not too happy.

question: Would you say your own health, in general, is excellent, good, fair, or poor?
In general, do you find life exciting, pretty routine, or dull?
On the whole, how satisfied are you with the work you do—would you say you are very satisfied, moderately satisfied, a little dissatisfied, or very dissatisfied?
response_options: 1 = very satisfied; 2 = moderately satisfied; 3 = a little dissatisfied; 4 = very dissatisfied.
respondent_scope: Asked only of respondents currently working, temporarily not at work, or keeping house (the item covers housework as well as paid work).

question: Would you say that most of the time people try to be helpful, or that they are mostly just looking out for themselves?
response_options: 1 = try to be helpful; 2 = just look out for themselves; 3 = depends.

question: Do you think most people would try to take advantage of you if they got a chance, or would they try to be fair?
response_options: 1 = would take advantage of you; 2 = would try to be fair; 3 = depends.

question: Generally speaking, would you say that most people can be trusted or that you can't be too careful in dealing with people?
response_options: 1 = can trust; 2 = cannot trust (can't be too careful); 3 = depends.

question: Compared with American families in general, would you say your family income is far below average, below average, average, above average, or far above average?
response_options: 1 = far below average; 2 = below average; 3 = average; 4 = above average; 5 = far above average.

question: During the last few years, has your financial situation been getting better, worse, or has it stayed the same?
How often do you read the newspaper—every day, a few times a week, once a week, less than once a week, or never?
response_options: 1 = every day; 2 = a few times a week; 3 = once a week; 4 = less than once a week; 5 = never.
